articles.title: Achieves Photorealistic Image Super-Resolution With Enhanced Flow Map Diffusion Models
articles.description: Researchers have developed FlowMapSR, a new image enhancement technique utilising a streamlined diffusion process and targeted refinement with prompts and adaptive training, to rapidly create highly detailed and realistic images from lower resolution originals.

articles.title: Alana Borland: From Christchurch to Ealing, why Trailfinders is living up to expectations
articles.description: There’s no hiding the fact that Trailfinders have been wildly unpredictable in the first half of the season. Yet Alana Borland believes there is a consistent, even metronomic, version of themselves waiting to emerge.

articles.title: Apple's 'Creator Studio' App Bundle Now Available for $12.99 Per Month
articles.description: Apple today launched the new Creator Studio that was initially unveiled two weeks ago, providing content creators with access to six Apple apps for $12.99 per month or $129 per year. Creator Studio includes Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, and Pixelmator Pro on Mac and iPad, along with Motion, Compressor, and MainStage on the Mac. Final Cut Pro is Apple's video editing software, Logic Pro is for audio editing and creation, and Pixelmator Pro is an image editing app that Apple purchased in 2024.
